notes: This is the ONE fixture where the transition/alert/routing outcome is NOT illustrative — context['data_quality_degraded'] = true is a real, directly-applicable context flag that Bitmomo_Watchtower_State_Transition_Engine::evaluate() checks FIRST, before every other rule (priority step 1), overriding everything else regardless of what the previous/new thesis pair actually looks like. Note previous_thesis and new_thesis here are intentionally near-identical (only source_record_id differs) specifically to prove DATA_DEGRADED overrides even what would otherwise be a clean NO_CHANGE.

alert_scenarios.single_scenario uses a last_alert_at_for_class only 11 minutes before 'now' (well inside the 60-minute cooldown) — should_alert is still true because DATA_DEGRADED maps to ALERT_CLASS_DATA_QUALITY, the second of the two COOLDOWN_EXEMPT_ALERT_CLASSES. Demonstrates Task 7's 'data degradation during cooldown' requirement.

routing.track is data_quality_reviewer regardless of the context['domain'] passed in ('derivatives' here) — Bitmomo_Watchtower_Analyst_Router::route() special-cases DATA_DEGRADED to always route to the data-quality track before it ever looks at domain.
